title: HexAGenT: Efficient Agentic LLM Serving via Workflow- and Heterogeneity-Aware Scheduling
authors: You Peng; Youhe Jiang; Wenshuang Li; Xu Xu; Ke Zhou; Jiawei Jiang; Chen Wang; Binhang Yuan
affiliations: HKUST, Webank, Wuhan University, Tsinghua University
research_focus: LLM serving, Agentic / Workflow serving, Multi-tenant scheduling, PD disaggregation, Performance modeling

problem_statement.en: Agentic LLM applications execute user requests as multi-step workflows whose DAG structure is revealed only incrementally at runtime, so users experience the end-to-end latency of the entire workflow rather than of any single LLM call. Existing per-call scheduling policies and PD-disaggregated systems do not jointly handle online-revealed workflow DAGs, heterogeneous prefill/decode placement, decode KV-capacity constraints, and cross-stage transfer latency on heterogeneous GPU clusters.
problem_statement.zh: Agentic LLM 應用將使用者請求展開為多步驟 workflow，其 DAG 結構僅在執行期間逐步揭露，使用者感受到的是整個 workflow 的端到端延遲，而非任何單一 LLM 呼叫。既有的 per-call scheduling 策略與 PD 解耦合系統，無法在異質 GPU 叢集上同時處理線上揭露的 workflow DAG、異質 prefill/decode placement、decode KV 容量限制與跨階段傳輸延遲。

key_innovation.en: A workflow- and heterogeneity-aware scheduler that models each request as an online-revealed DAG, maintains a running standalone-completion-horizon estimate H_w(t) per workflow, ranks ready calls by projected scaled-SLO risk, and jointly selects prefill placement, decode placement, and local queue priority while accounting for decode KV-capacity and cross-stage KV-transfer latency; plans are applied asynchronously so scheduling never blocks the serving path.
key_innovation.zh: 一套 workflow 與異質性感知的 scheduler：將每個請求建模為線上揭露的 DAG，為每個 workflow 維護持續更新的獨立完成時間估計 H_w(t)，依 projected scaled-SLO 風險對 ready 呼叫排序，並在考量 decode KV 容量與跨階段 KV 傳輸延遲的前提下，聯合決定 prefill placement、decode placement 與本地佇列優先權；scheduling plan 以非同步方式套用，確保不阻塞 serving 路徑。

key_improvements.en: Across representative agentic workloads and heterogeneous A100/H100/H200 clusters, reduces the SLO scale required for timely workflow completion by an average of 20.1% at 95% attainment and 33.0% at 99% attainment, with maximum reductions of 45.0% and 80.5%.
key_improvements.zh: 在代表性 agentic workload 與異質 A100/H100/H200 叢集上，將準時完成 workflow 所需的 SLO scale 平均降低 20.1%（95% attainment）與 33.0%（99% attainment），最大降幅分別為 45.0% 與 80.5%。

ai_task: LLM Serving, Disaggregated Prefill/Decoding, Multi-agent Systems
compute_memory_hw: NVIDIA A100, NVIDIA H100, NVIDIA H200
reported_accuracy: Not Reported (robustness study: avg Req99 degradation ≤1.5% for Llama, ≤9.5% for Qwen under 10-30% injected estimation error)

scope_assumptions.en: Scaled-SLO targets are defined relative to each workflow's standalone execution horizon on the same cluster; per-call output lengths are estimated via proxy-model-based sequence length prediction and service times via a roofline-style latency model; once a call starts prefill (or is locked to a planned decode instance) it cannot migrate. A robustness study shows the scheduler tolerates up to 30% multiplicative estimation error.
scope_assumptions.zh: Scaled-SLO 目標以各 workflow 在同一叢集上的獨立執行時間（standalone horizon）為基準定義；每次呼叫的輸出長度採 proxy-model 序列長度預測、服務時間採 roofline 式延遲模型估計；呼叫一旦開始 prefill（或已鎖定至規劃的 decode instance）即不可遷移。強健性實驗顯示 scheduler 可容忍最高 30% 的乘法性估計誤差。
